method.length: Sum native GetLength of every trace object by net/layer, including trace portions overlapping pads and pullup/testpoint branches. Pad geometry is not counted as a separate length. Package/module routes and via barrel length are not added. Not an electrical path-delay/skew calculation.
method.reference_projection: Straight track centreline samples no more than0.05mm apart; check filled In1 GND polygons plus GND pad/via copper. Holes within0.6mm used only for classification. Bottom In2 +3V projection reported separately. Not a return-current or field simulation.
